title: Map features
presetNote: Sets every line in the project. Fine-tune a single feature under its switch.
customWidthsNote: Custom widths. Pick a preset to reset every line.
buildingsHint: Engrave building footprints at map zoom {zoom} and closer.
railHint: Surface tracks use the local road width. Covered tracks appear as thinner dashes.
landNotCovered: No public land of these kinds here. Outside the United States and Canada, public land comes from OpenStreetMap where it is mapped: national parks, nature reserves (as preserves) and military land, without names.
landFromOpenStreetMap: Outside the United States and Canada, public land comes from OpenStreetMap where it is mapped: national parks, nature reserves (as preserves) and military land, without names.
landBoundariesNote: Each kind has its own dash. The width is shared with state and province boundaries. Names go inside the largest units that have room.
landUnitsNote: Turn a unit off to leave it out of the paint templates and boundaries, such as the forest around a park.
landUnitsNoteListed: Turn a unit off to leave it out of the paint templates and boundaries, such as the forest around a park. The largest {count} are listed.
landPaintNote: Each kind turned on gets a paper template per panel, cut to the land that stays visible after assembly. Where kinds overlap, the more specific one paints: a park over the wilderness and forest around it. US public lands from the USGS PAD-US database.
strokeWidthNote: Stroke widths are physical SVG values. Final engraved width also depends on focus, power, speed, material, and whether your laser software treats strokes as centerlines or filled shapes.
